items.title: *** Inside the AI sandbox: enabling responsible AI innovation 🦾***
items.description: *** Inside the AI sandbox: enabling responsible AI innovation 🦾*** How do you build and deploy high-risk AI systems in the EU without getting lost in the compliance? We pull back the curtain on the lessons learned and best practices from the AI regulatory sandbox pilot project conducted in collaboration with the @ EUCommission Directorate-General for Human Resources and Security (DG HR). The project focused on an AI system designed to support job matching in EU selection procedures. Moderated by Antje Prisker, this fireside chat brings together Sebastien Renaud from DG HR and Sonia Pérez Romero from # EDPS to discuss what it’s really like on both sides of the sandbox from legal clarity for the participating institution to practical insights for the supervisory authority. Why this pilot matters: 💡 Real solutions 🤝 EU collaboration on high-risk AI and much more 📽️ Check out the video below and learn more about our work on AI on the website 📃: https:// link.europa.eu/W9XTC9
